headline: Executive order sets up a White House initiative focused on Hispanic-Serving Institutions, colleges with large Hispanic student populations.
what_it_does: This order creates or continues a White House Initiative aimed at educational equity, excellence, and economic opportunity through Hispanic-Serving Institutions. These are colleges and universities that serve a large share of Hispanic students. No summary was provided, so the specific programs, funding, or duties set up by the order are not clear from the title alone.

who_it_affects.how: They are the focus of a White House initiative that may coordinate federal support for them.
They may be affected by federal efforts tied to their schools, though the specific effects are not described.
